items.title: 出口額遭雙重反超！今年上半年台韓出口額首度勝日 AI晶片讓「日本製造」掉隊
items.title_en: Export Values Double Overtaken! Taiwan and South Korea Export Values Surpass Japan for the First Time in H1, AI Chips Leave “Made in Japan” Behind
paras: 最新數據顯示，今年上半年以美元計價的台灣、日本、南韓出口額數字顯示，南韓上半年出口額 4963 億美元、台灣 4166 億美元，雙雙首度超越日本的 3844 億美元。日本雖年增近一成，台韓卻都飆漲近五成，寫下東亞出口版圖的歷史性位移。
綜合《CNBC》與《日本經濟新聞》等外媒報導，上述差距源頭在 AI 半導體「終端產品」的卡位。台積電吃下先進製程代工、三星與 SK 海力士壟斷 HBM，南韓今年上半年半導體出口額 1490 億美元 (佔總出口約 30%)，台灣 1332 億美元，南韓僅半年就超越 2025 全年 IC 出口額，而日本 IC 出口額僅 212 億美元，佔比 5%。
報導指出，日本雖在設備與材料端握有東京電子、愛德萬測試、Lasertec 等高市佔優勢，上半年半導體製造設備出口 150 億美元，高於台韓的 35 億及 52 億，但先進晶片處於 AI 資本支出風口，設備材料僅間接受益。
三菱日聯研究與諮詢公司 (MURC) 調查部副主任研究員丸山健太指出，零組件與設備出口難以複製終端晶片的高增速。
此外，產業結構性弱點還加上匯率與能源雙殺。日元處於數十年低位，壓抑以美元計價的出口額表現。
日本 6 月進口大幅年增 25.4%，創 2022 年 11 月來最高，石油進口金額飆 59.3%，主因中東局勢推高油價、87% 能源依賴進口的日本首當其衝。出口雖仍是經濟驅動力，但「高出口、更高進口」讓貿易條件惡化。
日本排名滑落並非 AI 浪潮下的偶然；1970-1990 年代出口穩居全球第三，21 世紀後先被中國大陸超越，再被荷蘭、香港擠下，去年跌至全球第六。
從紡織、鋼鐵到汽車電子，日本曾精準供應全球中端成品，卻在智慧手機、AI 伺服器、先進晶片等「最終產品」賽道失位。
本質上，日本遭台韓反超是將自身「上游強、終端弱」的產業斷層攤在陽光下，AI 基礎設施指數級擴張的紅利，優先灌入能把晶片封裝成算力商品的經濟體，而非只賣製程工具的供應商。
paras_en: The latest data shows that in the first half of this year, export values measured in US dollars were 496.3 billion for South Korea, 416.6 billion for Taiwan, both surpassing Japan’s 384.4 billion for the first time. Although Japan’s year‑on‑year growth was close to 10%, Taiwan and South Korea each surged by about 50%, marking a historic shift in East Asia’s export landscape.

According to reports from CNBC, the Nikkei and other foreign media, the gap stems from the AI semiconductor “end‑product” race. TSMC dominates advanced‑process foundry work, while Samsung and SK Hynix monopolise HBM. South Korea’s semiconductor exports reached $149 billion in the first half (about 30% of total exports), Taiwan’s were $133.2 billion, and South Korea’s half‑year figure already exceeds its projected full‑year IC export for 2025, whereas Japan’s IC exports were only $21.2 billion, about 5% of its total.

The report notes that Japan still holds strong market shares in equipment and materials, with companies such as Tokyo Electron, Advantest and Lasertec. Semiconductor manufacturing equipment exports in the first half were $15 billion, higher than Taiwan’s $3.5 billion and South Korea’s $5.2 billion, but advanced chips are at the centre of AI‑driven capex, so equipment and material firms only benefit indirectly.
Kenta Maruyama, deputy head of research at Mitsubishi UFJ Research and Consulting (MURC), said that component and equipment exports cannot replicate the high growth rate of end‑product chips.

In addition, structural weaknesses in the industry are compounded by a double hit from exchange rates and energy costs. The yen is at a multi‑decade low, suppressing export performance measured in dollars.

Japan’s imports in June jumped 25.4% year‑on‑year, the biggest rise since November 2022, with oil imports soaring 59.3% mainly due to higher Middle‑East oil prices; Japan relies on imports for 87% of its energy, making it hit hardest. Exports remain an economic driver, but “high exports, even higher imports” is worsening trade conditions.

Japan’s slide in the rankings is not accidental in the AI era; it was the world’s third‑largest exporter in the 1970‑1990s, was overtaken by mainland China in the 21st century, then by the Netherlands and Hong Kong, and fell to sixth globally last year.

From textiles, steel and automotive electronics, Japan once precisely supplied the world’s mid‑range products, but it has lost ground in “final‑product” arenas such as smartphones, AI servers and advanced chips.

Fundamentally, Japan’s overtaking by Taiwan and South Korea exposes its “strong upstream, weak downstream” industrial gap. The exponential expansion of AI infrastructure benefits economies that can turn chips into compute commodities, not just suppliers of process tools.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉AAOI業績亮眼 激勵矽光族群抱團亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: AAOI's Earnings Shine, Inspiring Silicon Photonics Sector to Rise
paras: 美股光通訊大廠 AAOI(AAOI-US) 上周五公布第 2 季財報，營收年增 86% 創歷史新高，並成功轉虧為盈，也帶動台廠光通訊族群今 (10) 日持續上攻，聯亞 (3081-TW)、華星光 (4979-TW)、聯鈞 (3450-TW)、光環 (3234-TW)、光聖 (3450-TW)、上詮 (3363-TW) 等多檔衝漲停，波若威 (3163-TW)、眾達 - KY(4977-TW)、統新 (6426-TW) 也大漲逾 7-9%
法人指出，AAOI 的超乎預期表現，對同樣深度佈局 AI 數據中心光互聯的 Lumentum(LITE-US) 和 Coherent(COHR-US) 構成利多，因 AI 資料中心持續擴張，對整個光通訊產業釋放正面訊號。
據 AAOI 公告營收，除了資料中心業務營收首度突破 1 億美元，在個別產品方面，800G 營收年增亮眼，營收較去 (2025) 年飆增逾 10 倍，也激勵同族群 Coherent(COHR-US) 與 Lumentum(LITE-US) 股價上周五飆漲 13.44％及 6％。
台廠矽光族群中，目前已先公告的幾家廠商， 7 月營收也繳出年月雙增的亮眼表現，推升近期股價上揚，包括聯鈞 7 月營收 12.2 億元、月增 7%、年增 98%；聯亞 7 月營收 5.01 億元，月增 19.2%、年增 177%；華星光 7 月營收為 5.01 億元，月增 11.8%、年增 31.01%；光環 7 月營收 9,604 萬元、月增 25.2％、年增 96.94%。
paras_en: US-based optical communication giant AAOI (AAOI-US) released its Q2 financial report last Friday, with revenue increasing by 86% year-over-year to a historic high, and successfully turning losses into profits. This also drove Taiwanese optical communication stocks, including Union (3081-TW), Hiwafer (4979-TW), Uniflex (3450-TW), Gigalight (3234-TW), Gigastone (3450-TW), and Upmost (3363-TW), to surge and hit their daily limits. Other stocks, such as Prowell (3163-TW), ZyXEL - KY (4977-TW), and Unitech (6426-TW), also rose by more than 7-9%.

Institutional investors pointed out that AAOI's better-than-expected performance is a positive factor for Lumentum (LITE-US) and Coherent (COHR-US), which have also deeply invested in AI data center optical interconnection. As AI data centers continue to expand, the entire optical communication industry is releasing positive signals.

According to AAOI's announcement, its revenue has broken through $100 million for the first time in the data center business. In terms of individual products, 800G revenue has increased significantly, with a year-over-year increase of more than 10 times compared to 2025. This has also inspired Coherent (COHR-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US) stocks to rise by 13.44% and 6% respectively last Friday.

Among Taiwanese silicon photonics companies, several companies that have announced their July revenue have also reported impressive year-over-year and month-over-month growth, driving up their stock prices. These include Uniflex with July revenue of NT$1.22 billion, up 7% month-over-month and 98% year-over-year; Union with July revenue of NT$501 million, up 19.2% month-over-month and 177% year-over-year; Hiwafer with July revenue of NT$501 million, up 11.8% month-over-month and 31.01% year-over-year; and Gigalight with July revenue of NT$96.04 million, up 25.2% month-over-month and 96.94% year-over-year.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉台積電買廠傳聞加持友達衝漲停 群創同步亮燈
items.title_en: TSMC's Rumored Purchase of Innolux's Plant Boosts Stock Price
paras: 市場傳出台積電 (2330-TW) 有意買下友達 (2409-TW) 台中中科廠、擴充先進封裝先進產能，並將依循與群創的合作模式，與友達發展先進封裝技術；友達今 (10) 日早盤爆量攻漲停，群創 (3481-TW) 也同步亮燈漲停。
友達過去曾多次表示不會投入先進封裝領域，但董事長彭双浪在最近法說透露，公司在先進封裝 TGV 和 RDL 製程都有進展，董事會通過 86.41 億元的新增資本支出，也有部分將用於 TGV、RDL 的試產線投資。
彭双浪強調，友達持續聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構，透過淘汰競爭力較低的低世代線，投資 AI 四支箭的新技術等高殖化應用。
paras_en: The market is abuzz with rumors that TSMC (2330-TW) is planning to acquire Innolux's (2409-TW) Central Taiwan Science Park plant to expand its advanced packaging capacity, and will collaborate with Innolux on advanced packaging technology in a manner similar to its partnership with ASE (3481-TW); as a result, Innolux's stock price surged to its daily limit on the 10th, with ASE also seeing a simultaneous surge to its daily limit.

Innolux had previously stated that it would not invest in the advanced packaging sector, but Chairman Wang Jyh-chheng recently revealed during an investor conference that the company has made progress in TGV and RDL processes, and the board has approved NT$8.641 billion in new capital expenditures, some of which will be used to invest in trial production lines for TGV and RDL.

Wang emphasized that Innolux will continue to focus on a light-asset operating model, activate its assets, and optimize its financial structure by phasing out lower-generation lines with weaker competitiveness and investing in high-value applications such as AI-related technologies.

items.title: iPhone Ultra配色曝光！首款摺疊iPhone傳有「兩顏色」、相機設計也外洩
items.title_en: iPhone Ultra Color Options Leaked: Foldable iPhone to Come in Two Colors, Camera Design Also Revealed
paras: 最新曝光的「iPhone Ultra」鏡頭保護配件圖片顯示，蘋果首款可摺疊 iPhone 可能將推出銀色與深藍色兩種配色。
根據《MacRumors》報導，爆料者 Sonny Dickson 近日分享了兩款第三方鏡頭保護蓋的圖片，這些配件專為套在「iPhone Ultra」的相機凸起模組上而設計，其中一款採用銀色，另一款則為深藍色。
Dickson 過去曾多次準確曝光蘋果產品的配件與模型機，包括他日前提前曝光的 iPhone 18 Pro 系列配色。
這些圖片亦進一步印證了今年 5 月的一項報導。
該報導援引《Macworld》供應鏈消息人士的說法指出，蘋果將推出經典的銀色與白色版本，另有一款類似 iPhone 17 Pro「深藍色」的靛藍色選項。
6 月時，另有消息將銀色列為首個獲得「確認」的配色，而同一週的另一項報導則稱，較深色的版本可能不會採用黑色。
而 Dickson 曝光的這些配件，則提供了目前為止最清晰的視覺證據，進一步確認銀色與深藍色兩種配色。
這種較為低調的配色策略與 iPhone 18 Pro 形成鮮明對比。據傳 iPhone 18 Pro 今年除了銀色外，還將新增深櫻桃紅（Dark Cherry）與淺藍色兩種配色。此前也曾有傳聞稱 Pro 系列將推出黑色版本，不過後續消息指出，蘋果最終決定今年不推出黑色款。
曝光的配件也清楚呈現了外界先前廣泛傳聞的可摺疊 iPhone 背面相機平台設計。從圖片來看，後置相機將配備兩枚水平排列的鏡頭，旁邊則設有膠囊形閃光燈與 LiDAR 光學雷達掃描器。
預計這款可摺疊的「iPhone Ultra」將與 iPhone 18 Pro 及 iPhone 18 Pro Max 一同於下個月正式發表。
paras_en: Newly leaked images of the "iPhone Ultra" camera protection accessories show that Apple's first foldable iPhone may come in silver and deep blue colors.

According to a report by MacRumors, leaker Sonny Dickson recently shared two images of third-party camera protection covers designed for the camera bump module of the "iPhone Ultra", one in silver and the other in deep blue.
Dickson has a history of accurately leaking Apple product accessories and model machines, including his recent leak of the iPhone 18 Pro series color options.
These images also further confirm a report from May this year.
The report, citing a supply chain source from Macworld, states that Apple will release classic silver and white versions, as well as a deep blue option similar to the iPhone 17 Pro.
In June, another report stated that silver would be the first color to be "confirmed", while another report from the same week suggested that the deeper color option may not be black.
Dickson's leak provides the clearest visual evidence to date, further confirming the silver and deep blue color options.

This more subdued color strategy contrasts with the iPhone 18 Pro, which is expected to come in silver, deep cherry, and light blue colors, in addition to a previously rumored black option that was later ruled out.

The leaked accessories also clearly show the camera platform design that has been widely rumored for the foldable iPhone's back. The rear camera will feature two horizontally arranged lenses, accompanied by a capsule-shaped flash and LiDAR optical radar scanner.
The foldable "iPhone Ultra" is expected to be released alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max next month.

items.title: 高薪僅入場券！矽谷搶人才大有多瘋？幫你開Slack、每天開會想怎麼追你、送上客製化禮物
items.title_en: High Pay, Only a Ticket to Enter: Is the Talent War in Silicon Valley Going Crazy?
paras: 美國財經媒體《商業內幕 (BI)》最新報導指出，薪水在 AI 人才爭奪戰中早已不是決勝關鍵，而是「誠意」與「懂你」的極致比拚，最新案例來自近期被 SpaceX 收購、估值高達 600 億美元的明星程式設計工具商 Cursor。
為了搶下一位頂尖工程師，Cursor 團隊甚至飛越半個地球、送上「土耳其吉他」，只為讓候選人感受到「非你不可」的獨特重視。
Cursor 人才招聘負責人 Matt Ward 在播客《People by WTF》中坦言，招募頂尖人才就像追求「根本高攀不起的人」。Cursor 會為每位重點對象開設專屬 Slack 頻道，協調晚餐、會面與各種「追求」細節，甚至每天開會討論如何說服對方。
Ward 曾得知一名備受追捧的候選人畢業於表演藝術高中、擅長古典小提琴，便專程在紐約找到一家特色樂器店，為其訂製一件罕見的弦樂器。
他說：「東西不貴，但那份用心、細節與獨特性才是重點。」
這種近乎「偏執」的招聘文化，源自執行長 Michael Truell 早期的堅持。為了招攬最初 10 名員工，Cursor 團隊曾採取「瘋狂手段」。在被拒絕後，直接飛往候選人所在的另一個大洲當面溝通。
如今，Cursor 規模擴大，流程更系統化，但核心邏輯不變。與其廣泛撒網，不如精準鎖定全球僅有的 50 位頂尖人選，並展開持久攻勢。
報導指出，這一現象折射出 AI 熱潮下人才市場的新現實。頂尖人才同時手握多家巨頭的百萬年薪、頂級股權與前沿項目邀約，最終決定去向的，往往是文化認同與被理解的感受。這場戰爭已改寫矽谷招聘規則，Meta 執行長祖克柏曾親自致信目標研究員，甚至送湯慰問；OpenAI 隨後也在招聘流程中加入「送湯」環節，足見高層親自下場已成常態。
當然，錢依然重要。谷歌前人力資源負責人 Laszlo Bock 指出，若能招攬到真正頂尖的 AI 研究者，即便花費 1 億美元對巨頭而言仍是「划算買賣」，因其創造的價值與阻斷競爭對手的戰略意義遠超成本。
Ward 還形容這些人才的待遇已超越 NBA 球星等級，但當薪資天花板被集體抬升後，真正的勝負關鍵早就從「價碼」轉向「靈魂共振」。
paras_en: A recent report by Business Insider (BI) reveals that salaries are no longer the decisive factor in the AI talent war, but rather a 'gesture' and 'understanding' to the extreme. A recent case comes from Cursor, a star programming tool company acquired by SpaceX for $60 billion.
To recruit the next top engineer, the Cursor team even flew halfway around the world to send a 'Turkish guitar' to the candidate, just to make them feel 'irreplaceable'.

Matt Ward, head of talent recruitment at Cursor, admitted in a podcast that recruiting top talent is like pursuing 'someone who is fundamentally unattainable'. Cursor sets up a dedicated Slack channel for each key target, coordinating dinner, meetings, and other 'pursuit' details, and even discusses how to convince them every day.

Ward learned that a highly sought-after candidate graduated from a performing arts high school and was skilled in classical violin, so he personally found a specialty instrument store in New York to commission a rare stringed instrument.
He said, 'It's not about the price, but about the thought, details, and uniqueness.'

This near-'obsessive' recruitment culture originated from the early insistence of CEO Michael Truell. To recruit the initial 10 employees, the Cursor team took 'crazy measures'. After being rejected, they flew directly to the candidate's location on another continent to communicate face-to-face.

Now, with Cursor's expanded scale and more systematic processes, the core logic remains unchanged. Instead of casting a wide net, they precisely target the global top 50 candidates and launch a sustained assault.

The report notes that this phenomenon reflects the new reality of the talent market under the AI craze. Top talent simultaneously holds million-dollar salaries, top-tier equity, and cutting-edge project invitations from multiple giants, and ultimately decides where to go based on cultural identity and feelings of being understood.

This war has rewritten the recruitment rules in Silicon Valley, with Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg personally sending a letter to target researchers and even sending soup to comfort them; OpenAI has also added a 'soup' segment to its recruitment process, showing that high-level executives are now commonly involved.

Of course, money still matters. Laszlo Bock, former head of human resources at Google, pointed out that even if it costs $1 billion to recruit a truly top AI researcher, it's still a 'worthwhile investment' for giants, as the value created and strategic significance of blocking competitors far exceed the cost.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉巨大上半年財報靚EPS達1.11元 股價重返百元價位
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Giant Posts Strong H1 Earnings, Reaches NT$100 Price
paras: 日前提前完成執行買回 4000 張庫藏股的巨大 (9921-TW)，平均買回每股價格爲 71.75 元，占股本比重 1.02%，在公布最新財報 2026 年上半年每股純益 1.11 元後，今 (10) 日湧入買盤推升股價重返百元價位，並觸及 101.5 元漲停價位區。
巨大 2026 年第二季營收重返成長軌道，營收達 166.7 億元，年增 5.8%，毛利率 24.2%， 第二季單季稅後稅後純益 6.3 億元，大幅年增 2.34 倍，單季每股純益 1.62 元，2026 年上半年營收 291.9 億元，毛利率 22.3%，年增 3.2 個百分點，稅後純益 4.35 億元，上半年每股純益 1.11 元。
巨大指出，儘管上半年代工業務受去年高基期及輸美時程調整等結構性因素影響，但隨著新車上市效益逐步發酵及市場需求穩健回升，集團第二季營運動能強勁反彈，單季營收重返成長軌道。
巨大集團上半年自有品牌業務展現強勁韌性，歐美市場受惠於新年度車款上市帶動銷售成長，中國市場亦在第二季重返增長軌道，累計衰退比率持續收窄。特別是在第二季，GIANT 品牌推出的全新空力旗艦車款 Propel 銷售極為暢旺，加上高毛利的自有品牌產品比重顯著提升，且無須大幅折扣出清，帶動獲利結構大幅改善。
展望下半年，巨大指出，巨大集團對整體營運回升保持審慎樂觀。歐洲市場庫存調整已近尾聲，隨傳統銷售旺季到來及新年度車款全球陸續上市，需求顯著回溫；中國市場則持續受惠於騎行熱潮需求穩定，市場表現穩健。然美國市場受到地緣政治及外部不確定因素影響，消費趨勢仍顯保守，集團將密切關注市場變化以靈活因應。
巨大指出，面對全球總體環境的挑戰，巨大將持續透過全新產品的推出帶動高毛利產品比重，並憑藉強大的品牌影響力與全球通路韌性，維持穩健的經營步調與獲利品質。
paras_en: Giant (9921-TW) has completed its buyback of 4,000 treasury shares ahead of schedule, with an average purchase price of NT$71.75 per share, accounting for 1.02% of its outstanding shares. Following the release of its latest earnings report, which showed NT$1.11 in earnings per share for the first half of 2026, the stock price surged on July 10, reaching NT$101.5 and hitting the upper limit.

Giant's second-quarter revenue rebounded to growth, reaching NT$166.7 billion, a 5.8% year-over-year increase. Its gross margin was 24.2%, and its second-quarter net profit was NT$63 million, a 2.34-fold increase from the same period last year. The company's second-quarter earnings per share were NT$1.62, while its first-half revenue was NT$291.9 billion, with a gross margin of 22.3% and a year-over-year increase of 3.2 percentage points. Its first-half net profit was NT$435 million, and its earnings per share were NT$1.11.

Giant stated that despite the impact of last year's high base period and the adjustment of the US delivery schedule on its operations, the company's second-quarter revenue rebounded strongly, with single-quarter revenue returning to growth.

Giant's self-owned brand business showed strong resilience in the first half of the year, with the European market benefiting from the launch of new car models and the Chinese market returning to growth in the second quarter. The company's cumulative decline rate continued to narrow. In particular, the GIANT brand's new flagship car model, Propel, was extremely popular in the second quarter, and the proportion of high-margin self-owned brand products increased significantly, with no need for significant discounts, leading to a significant improvement in profitability.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, Giant stated that the company remains cautiously optimistic about its overall operations. The European market's inventory adjustments are nearing completion, and the traditional sales peak season is approaching, along with the global launch of new car models, which is expected to drive demand. The Chinese market will continue to benefit from the stable demand for cycling, while the US market will be affected by geopolitical and external uncertainty, with consumer trends remaining conservative. The company will closely monitor market changes and respond flexibly.

Giant stated that in the face of global challenges, the company will continue to drive high-margin product ratios through the launch of new products and maintain a stable operating pace and profitability through its strong brand influence and global distribution resilience.

items.title: 華新科焦佑衡：訂單穩定向上能見度非常好 漲價「勢在必行」
items.title_en: Hua Shin Ko's Chairman Focuses on Stable Orders and Rising Prices
paras: 被動元件大廠華新科 (2492-TW) 董事長焦佑衡今 (10) 日表示，最近訂單狀況不錯、穩定往上走，能見度非常好、達年底，部分產品會更遠一點，而在成本上漲、供需緊俏下，產品漲價「勢在必行」。
焦佑衡表示，這次缺貨狀況跟過去全面缺有點不太一樣，主要是某些特殊的品項蠻缺的，也將針對在 AI 相關領域的各式被動元件擴產，由於廠房很多空間先前早已準備，因此這次擴充會比較快速。
針對產品漲價，焦佑衡解釋，目前整體成本上升，像是稀土漲很多、取得相當困難，幸好集團本身有掌握相關技術資源，其他像是建廠、人力等成本都在漲，所以漲價是勢在必行，有些產品是比較緊俏，也會依市況適當調整。
總經理曾明燦補充，最近 2-3 個月的接單出貨比 (BB Ratio) 都超過 1.8，高於先前的 1.4 水準，平均訂單能見度半年，AI 客戶有比較長一點，以目前產品來看，電容、電阻的需求都不錯。
曾明燦表示，目前高雄、中國東莞大朗及馬來西亞的產能都接近滿載，下半年也持續擴產因應，預計到今年底整體產能將增加 10%，全年資本支出將提升至近 40 億元，明年則規劃再擴產 10%。
paras_en: Hua Shin Ko (2492-TW) Chairman Focus Yeh said on October 10th that the recent order situation is good and stable, with a high visibility until the end of the year. Some products will be further ahead, and with rising costs and tight supply, product prices are 'inevitable'.

Focus Yeh noted that this time's shortage situation is a bit different from the previous overall shortage. Some special items are quite short, and the company will expand production of various passive components in the AI-related field. Since the factory has many spaces prepared in advance, this expansion will be faster.

Regarding product price increases, Focus Yeh explained that the overall cost is rising, such as rare earths rising significantly and being very difficult to obtain. Fortunately, the group has mastered relevant technical resources. Other costs such as construction and labor are also rising, so price increases are inevitable. Some products are in short supply and will be adjusted according to market conditions.

CEO Tseng Ming-Chan added that the recent 2-3 month order shipment ratio (BB Ratio) has exceeded 1.8, higher than the previous 1.4 level. The average order visibility is half a year, and AI customers have a longer one. With the current products, the demand for capacitors and resistors is good.

Tseng Ming-Chan said that the production capacity in Kaohsiung, Dongguan, and Malaysia is almost full, and the second half of the year will continue to expand production accordingly. It is expected that the overall production capacity will increase by 10% by the end of the year, and the total capital expenditure will increase to nearly NT$4 billion this year. Next year, it is planned to expand production by another 10%.

items.title: 台灣迎史上最大財富繼承潮 永達保經提「三解方」破解傳承地雷
items.title_en: Taiwan Faces Largest Wealth Succession Wave in History, Evertrust Financial Offers "Three Solutions" to Overcome Pitfalls
paras: 少子化與高齡化正快速改變社會與家庭結構，據國發會資料顯示，2025 年台灣 65 歲以上老年人口占比超過 20%，正式邁入超高齡社會，伴隨而來的是台灣史上最大規模的財富「大繼承潮」。然而，龐大財富的轉移若缺乏妥善規劃，往往成為撕裂家庭情感的導火線。永達保經指出，現代人傳承最常踩中「不動產難變現」與「特留分爭議」兩大地雷，而保險具備獨特的法律架構與功能性，可透過控制權、分期給付、預留稅源三大功能，讓資產傳承不留遺憾。
永達保經觀察，許多台灣長輩習慣將資金投入房地產，卻忽略了下一代在繼承時的現金流危機。當長輩身故，子女若無足夠現金繳納高額遺產稅，恐面臨房產遭法拍或被迫賤賣的窘境。此外，隨著家庭結構多元化，傳統的「特留分」規定未必符合長輩真實的分配意願，即便立下遺囑，也常因特留分引發家族訴訟。
針對這些痛點，永達保經建議，傳承規劃應秉持「以終為始」的核心理念。許多人誤以為傳承是高資產族群的專利，但事實上，只要名下擁有房屋、存款、股票等資產，就應提前思考分配。
相較於其他金融工具，保險在傳承中的核心價值在於「穩定性」。透過利變型增額終身壽險的規劃，不僅具備終身有效之風險保障與穩定增長的特性，還能透過指定受益人機制突破特留分限制，將財富留給想照顧的人；同時，保險理賠金能發揮高槓桿價值，為子女預留繳納稅款的現金，成功保全家族的不動產與事業。
針對許多高資產長輩的傳承盲點，永達保經總經理特助吳柏瑨特別提醒，必須將「規劃的工具」與「賺錢的工具」分開看待。實務上，許多長輩過早將資產轉移至子女名下，卻面臨子女理財不當而流失家業的風險。
建議父母應善用保險「享有掌控權」的特性，以自己為要保人與被保險人，將資產主導權優先用於保障自己的晚年尊嚴。若擔心子女揮霍，還能啟用「分期給付」機制，將冰冷的數字轉化為長期穩定的照顧。此外，亦可搭配信託機制，同時兼顧控制權、隱私及法律風險。
paras_en: Taiwan is facing its largest wealth succession wave in history, with the 65-and-older population expected to exceed 20% in 2025, marking the country's entry into a super-aged society. This has led to a massive transfer of wealth, but without proper planning, it often becomes a trigger for emotional rifts within families. Evertrust Financial pointed out that modern people often step on two landmines: "difficulty in converting real estate into cash" and "disputes over reserved shares," and insurance has a unique legal framework and functional capabilities that can be used to control rights, make phased payments, and reserve tax sources, allowing for asset succession without regrets.

Evertrust Financial observed that many Taiwanese seniors tend to invest their funds in real estate, ignoring the cash flow crisis their children may face when inheriting. When seniors pass away, their children may struggle to pay the high inheritance tax, risking the loss of their property to foreclosure or forced sale. Additionally, with the increasing diversity of family structures, traditional "reserved shares" regulations may not align with the seniors' true distribution intentions, even if they have left a will, often leading to family lawsuits.

To address these pain points, Evertrust Financial recommends that succession planning should be guided by the core concept of "starting from the end." Many people mistakenly believe that succession is the exclusive domain of high-net-worth individuals, but in fact, anyone with assets such as houses, savings, or stocks should think ahead about distribution.

Compared to other financial tools, insurance has a core value in succession planning: stability. Through the planning of variable life insurance, not only does it provide lifelong risk protection and stable growth, but it also allows for the specified beneficiary mechanism to break through the reserved shares limit, leaving wealth for those who care for them; at the same time, insurance claims can play a high-leverage role, reserving cash for children to pay taxes, successfully preserving family property and businesses.

In response to many high-net-worth seniors' succession blind spots, Evertrust Financial's Deputy General Manager Wu Boxuan specifically reminds that "planning tools" and "earning tools" should be viewed separately. In practice, many seniors have prematurely transferred assets to their children, only to face the risk of losing their family business due to their children's poor financial management.

Evertrust Financial suggests that parents should make good use of insurance's "enjoyment of control rights" feature, using themselves as the insured and the beneficiary, prioritizing asset ownership rights to ensure their own dignity in old age. If they worry about their children wasting money, they can also activate the "phased payment" mechanism, converting cold numbers into long-term stable care. Additionally, they can combine this with trust mechanisms, balancing control rights, privacy, and legal risks.

台廠矽光族群中，目前已先公告的幾家廠商， 7 月營收也繳出年月雙增的亮眼表現，推升近期股價上揚，包括聯鈞 7 月營收 12.2 億元、月增 7%、年增 98%；聯亞 7 月營收 5.01 億元，月增 19.2%、年增 177%；華星光 7 月營收為 5.01 億元，月增 11.8%、年增 31.01%；光環 7 月營收 9,604 萬元、月增 25.2％、年增 96.94%。
paras_en: US-based optical communication giant AAOI (AAOI-US) released its Q2 financial report last Friday, with revenue increasing by 86% year-over-year to a historic high, and successfully turning losses into profits. This also drove Taiwanese optical communication stocks, including Union (3081-TW), Hiwafer (4979-TW), Uniflex (3450-TW), Gigalight (3234-TW), Gigastone (3450-TW), and Upmost (3363-TW), to surge and hit their daily limits. Other stocks, such as Prowell (3163-TW), ZyXEL - KY (4977-TW), and Unitech (6426-TW), also rose by more than 7-9%.

Institutional investors pointed out that AAOI's better-than-expected performance is a positive factor for Lumentum (LITE-US) and Coherent (COHR-US), which have also deeply invested in AI data center optical interconnection. As AI data centers continue to expand, the entire optical communication industry is releasing positive signals.

According to AAOI's announcement, its revenue has broken through $100 million for the first time in the data center business. In terms of individual products, 800G revenue has increased significantly, with a year-over-year increase of more than 10 times compared to 2025. This has also inspired Coherent (COHR-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US) stocks to rise by 13.44% and 6% respectively last Friday.

Among Taiwanese silicon photonics companies, several companies that have announced their July revenue have also reported impressive year-over-year and month-over-month growth, driving up their stock prices. These include Uniflex with July revenue of NT$1.22 billion, up 7% month-over-month and 98% year-over-year; Union with July revenue of NT$501 million, up 19.2% month-over-month and 177% year-over-year; Hiwafer with July revenue of NT$501 million, up 11.8% month-over-month and 31.01% year-over-year; and Gigalight with July revenue of NT$96.04 million, up 25.2% month-over-month and 96.94% year-over-year.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉台積電買廠傳聞加持友達衝漲停 群創同步亮燈
items.title_en: TSMC's Rumored Purchase of Innolux's Plant Boosts Stock Price
paras: 市場傳出台積電 (2330-TW) 有意買下友達 (2409-TW) 台中中科廠、擴充先進封裝先進產能，並將依循與群創的合作模式，與友達發展先進封裝技術；友達今 (10) 日早盤爆量攻漲停，群創 (3481-TW) 也同步亮燈漲停。
友達過去曾多次表示不會投入先進封裝領域，但董事長彭双浪在最近法說透露，公司在先進封裝 TGV 和 RDL 製程都有進展，董事會通過 86.41 億元的新增資本支出，也有部分將用於 TGV、RDL 的試產線投資。
彭双浪強調，友達持續聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構，透過淘汰競爭力較低的低世代線，投資 AI 四支箭的新技術等高殖化應用。
paras_en: The market is abuzz with rumors that TSMC (2330-TW) is planning to acquire Innolux's (2409-TW) Central Taiwan Science Park plant to expand its advanced packaging capacity, and will collaborate with Innolux on advanced packaging technology in a manner similar to its partnership with ASE (3481-TW); as a result, Innolux's stock price surged to its daily limit on the 10th, with ASE also seeing a simultaneous surge to its daily limit.

Innolux had previously stated that it would not invest in the advanced packaging sector, but Chairman Wang Jyh-chheng recently revealed during an investor conference that the company has made progress in TGV and RDL processes, and the board has approved NT$8.641 billion in new capital expenditures, some of which will be used to invest in trial production lines for TGV and RDL.

Wang emphasized that Innolux will continue to focus on a light-asset operating model, activate its assets, and optimize its financial structure by phasing out lower-generation lines with weaker competitiveness and investing in high-value applications such as AI-related technologies.

items.title: 山盟公益講座：走進歐洲高山現場 探索馬特洪峰後的攀登哲學
items.title_en: Exploring the Philosophy of Climbing after Conquering the Matterhorn
paras: 許多攀登者視瑞士馬特洪峰（Matterhorn）為一生的夢想，但登頂之後，攀登的意義又是什麼？山盟公益協會將於 8 月 17 日（一）晚間 7 點，在台北主辦《攀登馬特洪峰，之後——入門者的歐洲攀登手札》公益講座，特別邀請戶外教育工作者陳冠元，分享他於 2026 年夏天在歐洲高山現場的真實觀察與反思。
馬特洪峰以其標誌性的金字塔外型聞名，其中最受歡迎的 Hörnli Ridge 路線，雖被視為「最容易」的途徑，但實則充滿挑戰。根據記錄，這條路線地形極度暴露，且為了避開惡劣天氣與擁擠人潮，攀登者必須維持如同「短跑衝刺」般的高效率速度。陳冠元在此次旅程中，不僅順利完成 Hörnli Ridge，更深入攀登聖地霞慕尼（Chamonix），挑戰了 Arête de la Table 等多條經典路線。
本次講座不以展現「壯舉」為目的，而是希望透過一名入門者的視角，深入探討海外攀登的技術準備、風險判斷與當地的嚮導文化。陳冠元將分享他在面對「馬特洪峰掌握主導權」的極限環境下，如何調整心理素質與應變策略，並帶領聽眾思考如何將這些經驗轉化為未來技術訓練的養分。
講座地點位於山盟公益協會（台北市中山區中山北路三段 27 號 5 樓），採免費報名，限額 60 人。

paras_en: Many climbers consider conquering the Matterhorn in Switzerland a lifelong dream, but what does climbing mean after reaching the summit? The Mountain Alliance Charity Association will host a public lecture, "Climbing the Matterhorn, Afterwards - A Beginner's European Climbing Handbook," on August 17 at 7 PM in Taipei, inviting outdoor education worker Chen Guan-yuan to share his real observations and reflections from his European high-altitude expedition in the summer of 2026.

The Matterhorn is famous for its pyramid-shaped silhouette, with the most popular Hörnli Ridge route considered the "easiest" path, but it's actually full of challenges. According to records, this route has extremely exposed terrain, and climbers must maintain a high-efficiency speed, like a sprint, to avoid bad weather and crowded routes. Chen Guan-yuan successfully completed the Hörnli Ridge route and further explored the climbing mecca of Chamonix, challenging multiple classic routes, including the Arête de la Table.

This lecture is not intended to showcase "heroic feats" but to delve into the technical preparation, risk assessment, and local guide culture of overseas climbing through the eyes of a beginner. Chen Guan-yuan will share how he adjusted his mental quality and response strategies in the extreme environment of the Matterhorn and lead the audience to think about how to transform these experiences into future technical training.

The lecture will be held at the Mountain Alliance Charity Association (5F, No. 27, Section 3, Zhongshan North Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei City) and is free to attend, with a limited capacity of 60 people.
